description: Creates a mailto draft link and an RFC 822 .eml file. Use when the user wants to email someone, draft an email, or prepare a message for Apple Mail, Outlook, or Thunderbird. Returns a mailto: URL that opens their desktop or mobile email client with recipient, subject, and body pre-filled, plus the complete .eml MIME draft text. Nothing is stored and no email is sent by our server.

bcc.description: Optional BCC email address or comma-separated addresses.

body.description: Email body text (at most 50,000 characters). Plain text or formatted with line breaks.

cc.description: Optional CC email address or comma-separated addresses.

to.description: Recipient email address or comma-separated addresses.

name: draft_email

character_count.description: Length of the email body in characters.

eml_content.description: RFC 822/5322 .eml MIME draft text ready to save or open.

filename.description: Suggested file name for the .eml file.

mailto_url.description: RFC 6068 mailto URI for instant client-side draft opening.

url_length.description: Total length of the mailto URL.

warning.description: Warning if the mailto URL exceeds safe client length limits.

title: Draft email
